title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Exodus 34: the new stone tablets, the name of Yahweh proclaimed, the covenant renewed and Moses' shining face.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Moses to chisel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: "Chisel two stone tablets like the first."

answers.text: A new ark of acacia wood
A stone altar for the offerings
Two stone tablets like the first

questions.text: What instruction was given about the flocks and herds?
questions.explanation: No one was to come up with Moses, and the flocks and herds were not to graze in front of that mountain.

answers.text: They had to be brought up the mountain
They had to be kept inside the camp for forty days
They must not graze in front of the mountain

questions.text: Which phrase did Yahweh use about himself when he passed by Moses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh proclaimed that he is a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

questions.text: What did Moses do when Yahweh passed by and proclaimed his name?
questions.explanation: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

answers.text: He hid his face in his cloak
He bowed his head and worshiped
He ran back down the mountain
He cried out with a loud voice

questions.text: What were the Israelites to cut down?
questions.explanation: They were to break down the altars, dash in pieces the pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles of the people of the land.

questions.text: What is Yahweh's name according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: They were to worship no other god, for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

questions.text: With what was the firstborn of a donkey to be redeemed?
questions.explanation: The firstborn of a donkey was to be redeemed with a lamb; if not, its neck was to be broken.

questions.text: In which times were they still to rest on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: They were to work six days and rest on the seventh: in plowing time and in harvest they were to rest.

answers.text: In plowing time and in harvest

questions.text: What did Moses do during the forty days and forty nights with Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He neither ate bread nor drank water, and he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

answers.text: He ate manna once a day
He ate and drank with the elders
He neither ate bread nor drank water

questions.text: What did Moses put on his face after he finished speaking with the people?
questions.explanation: The skin of Moses' face shone, and when he was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
